title: Mergrass
summary: Extract three Mergrass into Suspension of Mergrass, a Potion of Mind Reading ingredient.

fields.Alchemy: Combine three Mergrass to extract one Suspension of Mergrass, then combine the suspension with any Sublimate to create Potion of Mind Reading.
fields.Potion effect: The finished potion is a Bonus Action consumable. It grants Detect Thoughts until Long Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Myconid Colony.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
